units.source_text: 朱雀院自从斋宫下伊势那天在大极殿举行庄严仪式时看到了她的美貌之后，至今不能忘怀。

en.t: Ever since the day the Saigu went down to Ise, when he saw her beauty during the solemn ceremony at the Daigoku-den, Retired Emperor Suzaku had been unable to forget her.

units.source_text: 后来斋宫返京，他曾对六条妃子说：“让她进宫来，和斋院等姐妹们住在一起吧。”

en.t: Later, after the Saigu returned to the capital, he once said to the Rokujo lady, "Let her come into the palace and live together with her sisters, the Saiin and the others."

units.source_text: 但六条妃子不敢答应，她想：“宫中身份高贵的妃嫔甚多，而我这边没有忠诚的保护人，如何去得？”

en.t: But the Rokujo lady did not dare consent, thinking, "There are many high-ranking consorts in the palace, while on my side there is no loyal protector. How could she go there?"

units.source_text: 并且她还有顾虑：“朱雀院身体很不好，也是可担心的。

en.t: Moreover, she had another concern: "Retired Emperor Suzaku is in very poor health, and that too is worrying.

units.source_text: 设有不讳，岂不教我女儿和我一样守寡么？”

en.t: If the worst should happen, would that not make my daughter live as a widow, just as I have?"

units.source_text: 因此迟疑不决，因循度日。

en.t: For that reason she remained hesitant and undecided, letting the days pass in delay.

units.source_text: 但现在六条妃子死了，众侍女都替前斋宫担忧：现在更加没有保护人了。

en.t: But now the Rokujo lady had died, and all the gentlewomen worried for the former Saigu: now she had even less of a protector.

units.source_text: 正在此时，朱雀院又诚恳地提出他的愿望。

en.t: Just at this time, Retired Emperor Suzaku once again expressed his wish with sincere earnestness.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣闻此消息，心念违背了朱雀院的愿望而夺取这女子，是对人不起的。

en.t: When Genji, the Inner Minister, heard this news, he thought that to go against Retired Emperor Suzaku's wish and take the young woman for himself would be unfair to him.

units.source_text: 而放弃这个绝色美人，又甚可惜。

en.t: Yet to give up such a peerless beauty would also be a great pity.

units.source_text: 他就去和师姑藤壶皇后商量。

en.t: So he went to consult Empress Fujitsubo, who was like an aunt and teacher to him.
